fields.statement: Change set 01M6GCP (Fix: plan-run close-out fails on untracked .rhiza/log entries) serves no intent yet. Which landed intent should it serve? Recommendation: m24-on-the-vm, the intent the previous Fix (folder trust) served. This one is also a failure the VM's unattended daemon runs into. / How should close-out stop failing on .rhiza/log entries that sit untracked in the main checkout? Every change set opened in the main checkout (run start --new, change new) leaves its first entries there untracked, and the daemon reads drafts and accepted change sets from that checkout. Recommendation: close-out drops untracked log files that the incoming main has byte for byte, then pulls. This keeps the main checkout's view of in-flight change sets and fixes ship-change close-outs too. / `ship close-out --forget` deletes the ship state before it pulls main. If the pull fails, a retried close-out then fails with no ship state. How should a retry work? Recommendation: delete the ship state only after main is updated, so a retry finds it and finishes.
